estimator.spectrum_power: mean power per Fourier coefficient; curve mean normalized to 1
estimator.spectrum_boundary_treatment: separable Hann taper with window-weighted mean subtraction and mean-square-window power correction
estimator.normalization: source zero mean/unit RMS before feature measurement
estimator.event_method: along3 smooth; transverse9 median;4*MAD candidate threshold; connected half-local95%-contrast elongated cores; full candidate halo excluded from background; boundary-censored shapes excluded
estimator.envelope_method: RMS of Gaussian-smoothed squared field, sigma8 pixels

limitations: Fitted generated-noise statistics are an engineering prior, not measured sensor calibration.
Spectra, marginal tails and event statistics do not preserve exact generated phase/layout.
Sparse event segmentation is threshold dependent; per-source statistics remain separate.
Estimated background includes some filtering/segmentation error and line modulation.
No test/validation array contributes to fitted parameters.
